title: Block’s new voice model sounds eerily human
slides: Can Block's voice model pass as human?
It captures pauses and mid-sentence breaths
But those imperfections are generated on purpose
Call centers could soon deploy it for support
Listen closely next call—you might not tell
thread_text:
1. Can you tell?

Block's new voice model captures pauses and mid-sentence breaths so naturally that many listeners can't distinguish it from a human.

2. Purposeful flaws

Those imperfections—the ums, the sighs—aren't glitches. They're generated on purpose to make the AI sound more human.

3. Call centers next

Customer support lines could soon deploy this voice, replacing scripted bots with AI that sounds eerily real.

4. Your next call

You might be talking to an AI and not even realize it. The technology is already here, waiting to be scaled.

5. Test yourself

Listen closely on your next support call. Can you spot the AI? If not, would you want to know?
